include_directories(${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/win32ss)

spec2def(win32u.dll win32u.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)
add_asm_files(win32u_asm sys-stubs.S)

if (STACK_PROTECTOR)
endif()

# win32u.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/win32u-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(win32u_shims OBJECT main.c sys-stubs.S)
if(STACK_PROTECTOR)
    target_compile_options(win32u_shims PRIVATE -fno-stack-protector)
endif()
add_dependencies(win32u_shims psdk)
add_cargo_module(win32u win32u-cargo win32u.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS win32u_shims)
